headline: Belize Consumer Price Inflation Rises to 4.7% in September
summary: Belize's annual inflation rate accelerated to 4.7% in September 2026 from 4.4% in August. Increases were primarily led by rising transport, housing, and food expenses.
why: National inflation tracking provides essential data on purchasing power and cost pressures across Central American economies.

impacts.name: Belize
impacts.why: Higher consumer price inflation places upward pressure on household living costs and economic activity.
